risk_if_not_implemented: Without Unusual Transactions, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Fraud / Theft / Direct Financial Loss (R-EX-10), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14).

compensating_control_1.name: Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
compensating_control_1.description: Automated mechanisms exist to implement Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to protect sensitive information as it is stored, transmitted and processed.
compensating_control_1.justification: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) (DCH-40) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Transfer Activity Limits (MON-16.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Encrypting Data In Transit
compensating_control_2.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data in transit.
compensating_control_2.justification: Encrypting Data In Transit (CRY-05) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Transfer Activity Limits (MON-16.1) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
